summary: Zymeworks completed its acquisition of Theravance Biopharma via a Cayman merger, per a June 28, 2026 agreement. Each Theravance ordinary share was converted into $17.00 cash plus one contingent value right, with options and RSUs similarly cashed out and CVRs issued; out-of-the-money options were cancelled for no consideration. The filing does not disclose the board recommendation, advisor, premium, ownership split, or regulatory clock. The CVR terms, Theravance's remaining pipeline economics, and integration/cash-flow risks are the key post-close items to monitor, with CVR valuation likely the main arbitrage focus.
